data.body:
THE REMAINING GAP IS IMPLEMENTED AND PUSHED: Gerrit change 1147, commit 687c1a543b.

WHAT WAS ACTUALLY LEFT, verified in source rather than taken from the handoff. Change 1119 had
already moved plan-review's _verifier_cfg and completion's _verifier_model_for_completion onto the
standard class (both read resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS) today), and 1128 covered the xcheck
callers. CODE REVIEW was the only path still broken: gates/code-review.yaml's verify step declared
NO model: key at all, so it fell through to cfg.model, the FRONTIER model.

THE FIX IS ONE DECLARATION: `model: standard` on that step. It resolves because workflow/runs.py
does resolve_model(cfg, step=ctx.step.get("model"), workflow=...) and 7761 taught resolve_model to
resolve reserved class names. That is exactly why this ticket waited on 7761 -- before it, the same
line would have handed the runner the LITERAL string "standard" as a model id.
A CLASS name and not a literal id, deliberately: resolve_model precedence is step > workflow > cfg,
so a literal step id would out-rank the operator's class configuration. A class name defers to it.

SECOND, INDEPENDENT DEFECT THIS ALSO CLOSES, which is the part worth remembering: the verify step
carries `temperature: 0` for greedy Pass-2 determinism, and that setting HAD NEVER TAKEN EFFECT.
Running on the frontier model, pydantic-ai's Anthropic adapter silently drops temperature. So code
review's verification has never had the determinism its own config claims. Moving the step to the
standard class is what makes that setting real, not just the cost downgrade.

TESTS: tests/unit/test_code_review_verifier_class.py, 7 tests, all green (17 with the pre-existing
test_verifier_class.py). The observable is the id the ENGINE would resolve -- the shipped YAML run
through the real resolve_model -- never a reimplementation of the lookup.
The load-bearing one is a CROSS-PROVIDER SWEEP over all three verifier paths at once
(_verifier_cfg, _verifier_model_for_completion, the code-review step). They are independent code
paths that have already drifted apart once, and a cutover moving two of three still bills the third
to direct Anthropic -- or hard-fails in a Bedrock-only container with no Anthropic key.

MUTATIONS, each restored: `model: frontier` -> 5 fail. `model: anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6`
(a LITERAL id naming the very model standard resolves to today) -> 4 fail. The second is the one
that matters: it proves the tests demand the CLASS INDIRECTION, not merely the right model string,
so they cannot be satisfied by hardcoding the answer.

PROCESS DEVIATION, STATED PLAINLY: I did NOT hand this to a held-out implementation subagent. The
change is a single YAML key whose value is dictated by the AC text, so there is no implementation
space to over-fit and nothing for a held-out set to defeat. I authored the full contract first,
confirmed RED for the right reason (5 failures, all "resolved claude-opus-4-8"), then implemented
and mutation-checked. Every other code leaf in this epic did use the full held-out protocol.

resolve_verifier_model is NOT deleted. It still carries the superseded equality rule
(`verifier_default if model == default_model else model`) and it is exported in review_kernel's
__all__ and documented in docs/review-kernel.md, so removing it is a documented-API change and
outside this ticket's scope. Instead a test asserts NOTHING under src/rebar calls it -- verified,
it has zero production consumers, only the __init__ re-export and its own unit tests. A future
caller would silently reintroduce this exact defect, because provider-qualifying a model defeats
an equality test against the default.

GATES: make lint clean, make typecheck clean, all six generator/parity drift gates clean with no
derived artifact dirty, and 932 passed / 3 skipped across the code-review, verifier, workflow and
model-class unit suites.

AC STATUS: the four ACs about plan-review Pass-2/Pass-4, the completion verifier, the xcheck
callers, and the literal-id round trip were already satisfied by 1119/1128. This change adds the
code-review verify AC and the cross-provider AC. `grep -rn "== DEFAULT_MODEL" src/rebar/llm/`
returns only two COMMENTS that describe the retired rule in prose (config.py:44,
completion.py:276) -- no selection site, so that AC holds. NOT closing until 1147 is Verified +1.
